articles.title: Tata Electronics to make Qualcomm Automotive Modules in Assam under new pact with US chip giant
articles.summary: Qualcomm Technologies and Tata Electronics have partnered to manufacture Qualcomm Automotive Modules in Assam. This agreement signifies a major push for advanced technology manufacturing within India, promoting the 'Make in India' initiative and bolstering the domestic electronics sector. The venture will also create significant employment opportunities and foster skill development in the region.

articles.title: News 2/20/26
articles.summary: The University of Mississippi Medical Center closed all clinics following a cyberattack that crippled its Epic and other critical systems. This incident highlights the severe operational disruptions cyber threats pose to essential national infrastructure, particularly in healthcare. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the critical importance of robust cybersecurity for national security and resilience against modern, sophisticated threats.

articles.title: What sparked the “Larry Wheels Files”? Inside the Greg Doucette and Jon Bravo controversy
articles.summary: The US has reportedly outlined a plan for a 20,000-strong Gaza stabilisation force, presented during a Trump-led peace summit. Concurrently, Prince Andrew's alleged arrest is garnering significant attention, with the Giuffre family labeling it a monumental development amidst ongoing legal controversies. The news indicates major international security and royal-related developments.
